breakpoint.wide.note.value: wide (1280) is the original's second desktop breakpoint: many blocks keep their tablet or stacked layout until 1280, so the band 1024-1279 is its own responsive state (see each section responsive.desktop-narrow). Added to the clone mid-build by the responsive fix.

breakpoint.note.value: Declared breakpoints. Mobile layout below 768. Tablet 768-1023 was NEVER measured on the original; the clone stacks below 1024; 1024-1279 is a separate band handled by the responsive fix, which was still in progress at the snapshot date.
